<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Complaint" name="Complaint filed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Decision" name="Refund decision notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Refund" name="Refund sent"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Satisfaction feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Complaint Handling" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DecisionNotified" name="Decision notified" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RefundSent" name="Refund sent" sourceRef="Event_RefundSent" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FeedbackGiven" name="Feedback given" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Complaint Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer Service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResolutionMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Resolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DecideRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Financial" name="Financial Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_RefundSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ComplaintToLog</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Complaint" messageRef="Msg_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ComplaintToLog</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_LogToAssign</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_LogToAssign</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_AssignToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewComplaint" name="Review complaint details">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_AssignToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ReviewToDecide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideRefund" name="Determine validity and refund justification">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ReviewToDecide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_DecideToNotify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyDecision" name="Notify customer of decision" messageRef="Msg_Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_DecideToNotify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_NotifyToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundSplit" name="Refund approved?" default="SF_RefundRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_NotifyToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_RefundApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_RefundRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessRefund" name="Process reimbursement">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_RefundApproved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_RefundToSent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_RefundSent" name="Refund sent to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_RefundToSent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_SentToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RefundSent" messageRef="Msg_Refund"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" name="Case ready for resolution">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_SentToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_RefundRejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_MergeToResolve</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_MergeToResolve</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_ResolveToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Resolved" name="Complaint resolved">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_ResolveToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_FeedbackToRecord</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordFeedback" name="Record customer satisfaction feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_FeedbackToRecord</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_RecordToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Feedback" name="Feedback recorded">
      <bpmn:incoming>SF_RecordToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ComplaintToLog" sourceRef="StartEvent_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_LogToAssign" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_AssignToReview" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReviewToDecide" sourceRef="Task_ReviewComplaint" targetRef="Task_DecideRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_DecideToNotify" sourceRef="Task_DecideRefund" targetRef="Task_NotifyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotifyToSplit" sourceRef="Task_NotifyDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RefundApproved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RefundRejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundSplit" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RefundToSent" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefund" targetRef="Event_RefundSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_SentToMerge" sourceRef="Event_RefundSent" targetRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_MergeToResolve" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolutionMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ResolveToEnd" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="EndEvent_Resolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_FeedbackToRecord" sourceRef="StartEvent_Feedback" targetRef="Task_RecordFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_RecordToEnd" sourceRef="Task_RecordFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
